answers.text: Tell the assistant: read the driver's text and return exactly three lines, same order every time — drop-off time, pallet count, any damage noted. Three lines, that order, no more, no less.
Turn the week's call log into a list with time, customer, topic and outcome for each entry that needs a follow-up call.
The finishing time doesn't work — six hours from an 8am start on the 22nd would wrap up early afternoon that same day, not the 23rd. I'd check which date is right before this gets filed.
The invoice growth figure doesn't look right to me — 96 up to 118 seems bigger than a 20% rise.
I'd sign off on Output 2, it shows the actual ticket counts behind the 88%. Output 1 doesn't give you anything to check.
I'd go with Email 2, it's got real numbers behind it.
I'd be careful with the hourly rates before pasting that in anywhere.
I'd have someone cross-check the stock counts against the system before the monthly summary is sent out.
Step 1, where it reads the invoice PDF, is the one I'd watch — a bad read there messes up everything after it.
